plan: Given this is the first round and I have no history to learn from, I will bid my true value. This is a common strategy in first-price sealed-bid auctions where the winner pays the second-highest bid (Vickrey auction characteristics). Bidding my true value ensures I never pay more than my value and I win whenever my value is higher than the other bids.

This is a Vickrey auction (second-price sealed-bid). The optimal strategy in a Vickrey auction is to bid your true value. This strategy is dominant, meaning it's the best strategy regardless of what other bidders do. Bidding my true value of $22 maximizes my profit in the long run, as it guarantees I win when my value is higher than the second-highest bid and I pay no more than my value.

I will bid slightly above what I perceive as the optimal bid for a second-price auction, which is to bid my true value. However, since the payment is the second-highest bid, I want to win but pay as little as possible. Given my value is 13, I will bid slightly higher than 13 to increase my chances of winning while still aiming for a reasonable profit. I will bid 13.1.
